purpose: Fix the standalone URL-12 total-compression regression from the parser bookkeeping follow-up while preserving the Vortex writer gains.
change: Reserve the exact sum of the produced lane code counts once before appending lane buffers. Each batch can grow the output at most once. No estimated compression ratio, dataset selector, dictionary change, public API change, format change or new unsafe code.

machine.isa: AVX-512F + POPCNT, selected once per parse; existing SIMD lanes and selector unchanged

method.primary: Existing Vortex string-bench full serialized write, same seven prepared real caches and both budgets; existing mimalloc and current-thread runtime. release_debug, opt3, codegen-units1, LTO off, default x86-64 target, frame pointers. Seven timed iterations after three warmups; baseline/candidate order reversed on alternating columns. One process per column. Normal round-trip validation enabled. All accepted timings ran serially, after builds/tests/profile processing/binary hashing had completed.
method.native: Existing upstream native parse, train_and_compress and decompress_all benches; native bench profile/default allocator. Same real 1m URL /200k review inputs; TPC-H scale1.0 cap8388608 bytes each. Threshold.5 seed42 for URLs/reviews, threshold.2 for TPC-H. All budgets; --bench --timer os --bytes-format decimal --sample-count20 --sample-size1 --min-time0.1. Record actual sample counts. URL order: ae79, fixup, old9b; TPC-H: ae79, fixup; reviews: fixup, ae79. run_native_parser_fixup.py preserves exact commands/env in local artifacts.
method.data: Same unchanged benchmark corpus as onpair-parser-2026-10-29.json; no synthetic replacement or retraining/settings changes.
method.interpretation: Throughput gain is old_ms/new_ms-1. FSST is a control, never a correction factor. Small writer shifts comparable with controls should be treated as flat. This host is not exclusive. Decoder source is unchanged. Observed decoder shifts and separate repeat measurements are retained; no decoder optimization is claimed.

url_decode_confirmation.note: The full-suite URL decoder results were -10.03% / -8.58%. Isolated 100-sample confirmation reverses the URL12 sign: +6.20% then -5.55%; URL16 was -0.83% then +3.92%. No stable decoder change is established. All full-suite and repeat measurements are preserved.

checks: OnPair cargo test --release --locked, including Hegel properties and brute-force oracle
OnPair pinned Rust1.91 all-target/all-feature Clippy -D warnings and rustfmt
Vortex OnPair and string-bench library tests
Exact real/binary and cross-dataset compatibility against published Git fixup

diagnostics.status: The original URL12 regression is retained in the preceding report. Focused train-only profiles did not reproduce it; the full benchmark sequence did. Whole-suite profiles locate approximately14ms extra CPU in training and6ms saved in parsing; added training samples are mostly memcpy/munmap. Training source is unchanged. This supports an allocation-history interaction; exact allocator internals were not established. The reservation fixes the observed case in repeated native measurements without relying on the input identity.
diagnostics.stage_method: CPU-weighted 1000Hz Samply samples, verified ELF build IDs. Group samples under measured train_and_compress by contiguous training/parsing phases. First30 calls are12-bit, next30 are16-bit; approximate profiling diagnostics, not the unprofiled throughput table.
diagnostics.stages_utility: Alternating old/new training plus parsing in one process produced the same16,355,186 URL12 codes. Old9b output capacity32,358,400 tokens, ae79 capacity17,741,824; the regression was not caused by a larger final output allocation.

prior_evidence: onpair-parser-2026-10-29.json keeps the full per-commit parser comparisons, initial standalone regression and reverse-order confirmation; all negative results remain.
limitations: One x86-64 host; no ARM/NEON or AVX2 performance claim. No separate new tests were needed for the allocation-only change; existing forced scalar/SIMD/reused-buffer properties and exact compatibility checks exercise it.
